literal_meaning: এক লপ্ত (একটি অবিভক্ত অংশ বা লোট)
figurative_meaning_en: Unbroken; not divided into parts; continuous
example_sentences_in_bangla: শুরুতেই মাসের বেতন একলপ্তে দেওয়া হবে।
example_sentences_in_english: The salary will be paid in one lump sum from the beginning.
The work has to be completed in one continuous stretch.
note: This idiom emphasizes indivisibility, often used in contexts of payment or tasks.
